arabic text: ALLAH MUJHE LASHKAR E MEHDI SE MILA DE
english translation text: O ALLAH! HELP ME TO JOIN THE ARMY OF IMAM MAHDI (A.S)

arabic text: ALLAH MUJHE LASHKAR E MEHDI SE MILA DE\nAISA NA HO AAKA MERA HALMIN KI SADA\nDE,
english translation text: O ALLAH! HELP ME TO JOIN THE ARMY OF IMAM MAHDI (A.S),\nI HOPE MY MASTER (A.S.) DOESN’T HAVE TO ASK FOR A HELPER

arabic text: NAZRO KO MERI LAYAKE DIDAR BANA DE\nPARDA JO PADA HE MERI ANKHO PE UTHA DE\nHADI E ZAMA KARO PE PURNUR DIKHA DE
english translation text: MAKE EYES WORTHY OF SEEING MY HIM (A.S.),\nLIFT THE VEIL FROM MY SO I CAN SEE HIM,\nSHOW ME THE RADIANT FACE OF THE GUIDE OF THIS TIME.

arabic text: LIKH DE MERI TAQDEER ME MAULA KI GHULAMI\nHASIL MUJHE HO JAYE YE EZAZ DAWAMI\nHAR KHWAISH E DUNIYA KO MERE DIL SE MITA DE
english translation text: MAY IT BE IN MY DESTINY TO SERVE HIM\nGIVE ME THE OPPORTUNITY TO BE WITH HIM\nTAKE AWAY ALL WORLDLY DESIRES FROM MY HEART
